title: Use the base-rate thresholds as the near-neighbour baseline in the classifier comparison
body: The near-neighbour vote is the existing tag suggester: it flags a picture when enough of its 12 most similar pictures carry the tag. Since July its cut-offs move with how common the tag is (its base rate) instead of sitting at a fixed 55%/45%. The learning-curve and person-judges ideas (4 and 5) compare a small classifier against this vote, and they should run it with the shipped thresholds rather than the old fixed pair, or the classifier would be beating a baseline that no longer exists. Report how many add candidates the vote yields per tag, because where it yields fewer than 100 the top-100 comparison is uneven by construction.
